CFML Language Reference: Functions

Ceiling

Rounds a number up to the next whole number. Integers come back unchanged.

Category

Mathematical functions

Syntax

Ceiling(number)

Parameters

number
Any number.

Returns

An integer.

Usage

"Up" means toward positive infinity, so Ceiling(-3.7) is -3. Its counterpart, which rounds down, is Int. A common use is counting pages: Ceiling(RecordCount / 10) pages of 10 rows.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFQUERY NAME="GetParks" DATASOURCE="cfsnippets">
SELECT ParkName FROM Parks
</CFQUERY>
<CFOUTPUT>
<P>#GetParks.RecordCount# parks at 10 per page need #Ceiling(GetParks.RecordCount / 10)# pages.
</CFOUTPUT>
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<TR><TH>number</TH><TH>Ceiling</TH><TH>Int</TH></TR>
<CFLOOP INDEX="n" LIST="3.2,3.7,3,-3.2,-3.7">
<CFOUTPUT><TR><TD ALIGN="RIGHT">#n#</TD><TD ALIGN="RIGHT">#Ceiling(n)#</TD><TD ALIGN="RIGHT">#Int(n)#</TD></TR></CFOUTPUT>
</CFLOOP>
</TABLE>
